title: WebSocketBinaryHeader
description: Header metadata preceding raw binary payload (e.g. unencoded Arrow IPC stream batch) in WebSocket binary framing (opcode 0x02). Framing format: [4 bytes uint32-be: header_length] [header_length bytes: JSON header conforming to this schema] [raw binary payload bytes]. Eliminates base64 expansion overhead for high-throughput streaming.

topic.description: Stream topic name. Must be a declared topic in schema/stream/topics.yaml.

schema_major.description: Schema major version of the envelope (integer >= 1).

epoch.description: Outbox epoch for durable topics, publisher epoch for ephemeral topics.

producer_id.description: Identifier of the process instance that wrote the entry.

origin_ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant from the producer's clock.

payload_schema.description: Schema identifier the payload conforms to.

payload_length.description: Length in bytes of the following binary payload segment.
